title: DespawnCountdown
description: A lightweight client side mod that shows a countdown timer after you die, so you always know how long until your items despawn.
body:
# DespawnCountdown

This mod puts a small, clean countdown timer on your screen the moment you die, so you always know exactly how long you've got before your items are despawn.

![timer image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0813c5961fc74644756efdf240df55859fecb04f.png)

## How it works

- **When you die** a 5 minute timer pops up in the bottom right corner
- **When you reach your items** timer disappears automatically
